CustomField.description: Set by the user's "sync to financial system" action: Batch_FinancialSystemOrderSync creates the sales order in the financial system (Exact), stores Exact_Id__c / Exact_Order_Number__c, activates the order and clears this flag. The order waits while its account is not in the financial system yet.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The order is waiting to be created in the financial system (Exact).
CustomField.label: Sync To Financial System
